issues.jp_before: 二十歳[はたち]の息子[むすこ]さんが二人[ふたり]もいるんですか。それなら、もう五十歳[ごじゅっさい]近[ちか]い{わけですね|pt-wake}。
issues.problem: 二十歳 means exactly twenty (implies twins) and contradicts the English 'in their twenties'.
issues.action: Changed 二十歳[はたち] to 二十代[にじゅうだい].

issues.jp_before: 社長[しゃちょう]に頼[たの]まれたら、断[ことわ]る{わけにはいかない|pt-wake}。
issues.problem: Distractor ものではない ('one shouldn't refuse') is close to the intended meaning 'I can't very well refuse'.
issues.action: Replaced distractor ものではない with ことだ.

issues.jp_before: このバスに乗[の]れば、駅[えき]まで十分[じゅっぷん]で着[つ]く{はずだ|pt-hazu}。
issues.problem: Distractor わけだ ('so that means you'll get there in ten minutes') is natural with a ば-clause and close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced distractor わけだ with ものだ.

issues.jp_before: 説明書[せつめいしょ]の通[とお]りに組[く]み立[た]てた{はずなのに|pt-hazu}、机[つくえ]がぐらぐらする。
issues.problem: English 'I should have assembled it' reads as an obligation that wasn't met. はずなのに means 'I'm sure I did'.
issues.action: English changed to 'I'm sure I assembled it just as the manual says, yet the desk wobbles.'

issues.jp_before: 人間[にんげん]は弱[よわ]い{ものだ|pt-mono}。
issues.problem: English 'after all' could also fit わけだ (a conclusion); the English did not settle it.
issues.action: English changed to 'Human beings are weak by nature.'

issues.jp_before: この電車[でんしゃ]は急行[きゅうこう]だから、次[つぎ]の駅[えき]には止[と]まらない{はずだ|pt-hazu}。
issues.problem: Distractor わけだ ('it's an express, so that means it doesn't stop') is natural after だから and fits the meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor わけだ with ことだ.

issues.jp_before: 風邪[かぜ]を早[はや]く治[なお]したいなら、とにかくゆっくり休[やす]む{ことだ|pt-koto}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 休むことだ advice item (疲れているなら…休むことだ).
issues.action: Rewrote it as 風邪[かぜ]を早[はや]く治[なお]したいなら、体[からだ]を温[あたた]かくして水[みず]をたくさん飲[の]む{ことだ|pt-koto}。 and updated the English to match.
